sections.heading: **SAFETY FIRST** - You **SHOULD NOT** try to connect **AAPS** to a pod for the first time without having access to all of the following:

sections.heading: Your Omnipod Dash PDM will become redundant after the AAPS Dash driver activates your pod.
sections.summary: Explains that once AAPS activates a pod, the PDM can no longer talk to that pod; keep the PDM as a backup.

sections.heading: Your pod **WILL NOT** stop delivering insulin when it is not connected to AAPS.
sections.summary: Explains that the pod keeps delivering its programmed basal rates from the active profile when AAPS loses contact.

sections.heading: AAPS Profile(s) do not support 30 minute basal rate time frames
sections.summary: Warns that AAPS profiles cannot have basal rates starting on the half hour; the reader moves such rates to whole hours.

sections.heading: 0U/h Profile basal rates are NOT supported in AAPS
sections.summary: Warns that AAPS cannot use a 0 U/h basal rate and points to Disconnect pump or loop suspend with a temp basal instead.
